description: This PHP file defines an ExceptionSubscriber class that subscribes to exception events in a Symfony-based application. It sets appropriate HTTP responses when exceptions occur, distinguishing between HTTP-specific exceptions and general ones.

classes.name: ExceptionSubscriber
classes.description: A subscriber class that handles exception events in a Symfony-based PHP application, modifying HTTP responses based on exception type.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array registering 'onExceptionEvent' to handle Kernel's EXCEPTION events with a priority of -65.

methods.name: onExceptionEvent
methods.description: Handles exception events by setting HTTP response status codes and headers based on the type of exception.
